description:
📘 Learn how to track down Linux problems fast with my Troubleshooting Strategies eBook: https://learnlinux.link/sysadmin-ebook

🎓 Join my live, hands-on Nextcloud deployment class on December 12th. Bring your questions! Reserve your seat: https://learnlinux.link/nc-12-26

Learn how to use Podman on Linux in this beginner-friendly, hands-on tutorial! We'll compare Podman vs Docker, install Podman, run your first container, launch an Ubuntu container with an interactive shell, and deploy an NGINX web server with port mapping.

You'll also learn essential Podman commands for managing container images, stopping containers, and cleaning up unused resources. Whether you're new to Linux containers or exploring Docker alternatives, this tutorial will help you get started with Podman.
